headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, driven by AI and strong demand in large caps.
summary: Most listed firms reported double‑digit YoY revenue growth, with TCS, Infosys and HCLTech leading the top line. Operating margins remained healthy for the majors, while profit slipped at Persistent. AI‑related sales were highlighted as a new growth driver across several companies.

themes.title: AI‑driven growth
themes.detail: AI revenue crossed $3 bn at TCS and jumped 78% YoY at HCLTech, with other firms citing early momentum.

themes.title: Revenue expansion
themes.detail: All reporting companies posted YoY revenue growth above 9%, led by OFSS and Coforge in the exchange feed.

leaders.why: YoY revenue up 82% and operating margin 59.6%
YoY revenue up 61.5% with 24.2% QoQ growth
Largest revenue base, 24% operating margin and strong AI revenue

laggards.why: Net profit fell 25% despite revenue growth

domain_outlook.note: Mphasis noted a £35.4 m telecom‑related deal; overall impact unclear.
